I've been working as a software developer for about three years now, and I really enjoy the problem-solving aspect of it.
Last year I took a course on machine learning which opened up a lot of new possibilities for my career.
I think technology is changing the way we communicate, and it's both exciting and a little concerning at the same time.
One challenge I've faced recently is managing my time effectively when working from home. There are so many distractions.
If I had more free time, I would probably travel to Japan, because I'm fascinated by the culture and the food there.
